comments.content: Returning nullptr from resolveEntity may not reliably block external entities with Xerces; a null return typically means "I cannot resolve, use default". With setDisableDefaultEntityResolution(true) it may work, but the usual XXE-blocking pattern is to return an empty InputSource or throw a SAXException. Verify that external entities are actually blocked.

parser, entityBlocker and errReporter are owned by unique_ptrs but parser holds raw pointers to entityBlocker and errReporter via setEntityResolver/setErrorHandler. Because destruction is reverse of declaration, entityBlocker and errReporter are destroyed before parser, risking use-after-free during parser destruction. Declare the resolver and error handler before parser or keep them alive for the whole parser lifetime.
